name: @deepviewer/desktop
description: DeepViewer desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: node scripts/bump-build-number.mjs && vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.preview: node scripts/sync-upstream-overrides.mjs --build && pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --preview
scripts.release: node scripts/sync-upstream-overrides.mjs --build && pnpm build && pnpm run runtime && node scripts/package.mjs --sign && node scripts/notarize.mjs
scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm run runtime && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.package:arm64: pnpm build && pnpm run runtime:arm64 && node scripts/package.mjs --arch=arm64
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke-responses-scanner.mjs && node scripts/smoke-model-scanner.mjs && vitest run test/runtime-manager.test.ts test/app-lifecycle.test.ts
